t: Flomasta PipeGrip Elbow provides a push-fit water pipe solution for turning 22mm pipework neatly through 90°. With its dual locking system and green band indicator, it ensures a secure, leak-free connection without the need for tools or hot works. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are perfect for routing pipework around corners.
